description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this 30A Home!* 2 Spacious Balconies* 4 Bikes Included* TWO Community Pools- 1 is a block away* Gulfview Heights Beach Access- 700 yards* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Goatfeathers Rest., Local Catch Bar and Grill + local shops* 0.5 miles to Gulf Place: Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley, and more* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Light Shoes Beach Cottage, your sunny seaside escape where comfort meets coastal charm. This three-bedroom, three-bath retreat comes fully furnished for carefree coastal living and family-friendly fun. Step outside to your private backyard paradise, featuring a furnished patio perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Multiple covered balconies invite you to unwind in the fresh Gulf breeze. Inside, the bright and airy living room offers plush sofas and a smart TV, setting the stage for relaxed downtime after a day of sun and sand. You’ll be just steps from one of the community pools and about 700 yards from the beach. Spend your days splashing in the pools, strolling along the shore, or taking a short .5-mile ride to Gulf Place Town Center for shopping, dining, and local entertainment. The layout offers ample privacy and space, featuring a main floor guest room with a queen-size bed and a twin bed. Upstairs, you will find the master suite includes a king bed, a private en-suite bath, and a furnished balcony, while the additional guest suite offers a queen bed, its own private bath, and balcony access. Make Light Shoes Beach Cottage your next vacation tradition—where sun-soaked pleasure and easygoing leisure await!Old Florida Village is a small community of coastal homes accented with upscale touches. This quiet, gated community is ideally located in Gulfview Heights, only minutes to Gulf Place Town Center on the western side Hwy 30A. Old Florida Village features two sparkling, gated community pools for guests to enjoy. Take a stroll to Gulfview Heights beach access or dine at some local favorites only a block or two away. Come experience the Old Florida Village community and see why you’ll be returning year after year!The Bed Setup:1st FloorGuest Bedroom 1: Twin Bed and Queen Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedArea Attractions: Old Florida Village is perfectly situated, with Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Located in an upscale area of Hwy 30A, this pristine house is perched between Destin and Seaside. Just a 13-minute drive to Grand Boulevard Town Center with over 35 shops and restaurants, as well as the all-new state-of-the-art Boulevard 10 Movie Theater. Bike down to Blue Mountain Creamery for a cone or meander along the miles of trails! The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A comprises 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique among all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
